# V12 — privacy data map

*Generated by `scripts/qa/v12-privacy-data-map.mjs` from `apps/marketing-web/src/lib/legal/data-map.ts`, which
is the same file `/privacy` renders from. Do not edit by hand: edit the data map and re-run.*

This is the audit the brief's Part 24 asks for — database/API field → purpose → recipient → retention →
policy section — produced from the product rather than from a legal template. Where a column reads
**not approved**, that is the finding: no value for it exists anywhere in this repository, and the published
policy omits it rather than inventing one.

## 3. Disclosure to third parties

| Recipient | Consent record | What puts the data there | Policy section |
|---|---|---|---|
| agency | `SHARE_WITH_AGENCY` | the student buys a plan that includes agency support, or accepts an assignment | §3 |
| university | `SHARE_WITH_UNIVERSITY` | the student submits an application to that university | §3 |
| sponsor | `sponsor-link create/revoke record` | the student creates a read-only, expiring sponsor link and chooses its scopes | §3 |

Sharing is driven by application state, not by the policy text: a university receives an application when it
is submitted to that university, and an agency receives a case when it is assigned. The page says so
explicitly, so no reader concludes that every university holds every document.

## 5. Retention

| Record | Period | Source of the period |
|---|---|---|
| advertising | 6 months | Korean e-commerce consumer-protection law |
| contract | 5 years | Korean e-commerce consumer-protection law |
| payment | 5 years | Korean e-commerce consumer-protection law |
| complaint | 3 years | Korean e-commerce consumer-protection law |
| applicant documents | **not approved** | no value exists; `LEGAL_DEPENDENCIES.md` L8 is `OPEN` |
| account and profile | **not approved** | as above |
| audit and access logs | **not approved** | as above |

The policy publishes the rule it does follow — purpose achieved, then destroyed without delay — and the four
statutory commerce periods. It publishes no period for documents, accounts or logs, and no retention job
exists to enforce one. This is a launch blocker, recorded in REPORT §92.

## 6. Cookies and client storage

| What | Where | Sent to the server | Consent needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| refresh token | httpOnly cookie, `SameSite=Lax`, path `/api/v1/auth`, one per client app | yes, to that path only | no — strictly necessary |
| `hg.locale` | `localStorage` | no | no |
| `hg.<product>.sb`, `hg.<product>.theme`, `hg.student.compare`, `hg.student.currency`, `hg.uni.openNext`, `hg.agency.prefs` | `localStorage` | no | no |

A repository-wide scan for Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Segment, Mixpanel, Hotjar, Meta Pixel,
Sentry, PostHog, Amplitude and Microsoft Clarity returns **nothing**. There is no advertising, behavioural
tracking or third-party analytics, so there is no consent-requiring cookie — and therefore no cookie banner.
Hangyul's own `analytics_events` table is first-party and server-side.

## 7. Claims checked against the code

| Policy claim | Verified in | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| No card data is stored | `app/models/business.py` `Payment` — provider ref, status, amount, sanitised payload only | yes |
| Passport number is masked | `student_profiles.passport_number_masked`, last 3 characters | yes |
| Document files have no public URL | HMAC-signed 5-minute URLs after an authorisation check (`docs/SECURITY.md`) | yes |
| Every document access is logged | `audit_logs` with `subject_user_id` | yes |
| Out-of-tenant records are not disclosed | `app/services/access.py`, 404 not 403; `server/tests/test_security.py` | yes |
| Passwords cannot be reversed | Argon2id (`argon2-cffi`) | yes |
| Uploads are scanned | hook exists; **development uses a no-op scanner** | partly — §8 says uploads are scanned before review, which is true of the pipeline and not yet of production |

The last row is the only claim in the policy that production configuration does not yet fully support. It is
listed in REPORT §92 with the storage and scanning dependencies it belongs to.
